When things come to a head between them, Miyuu leaves home with a blank canvas in tow, holding on to the hope that painting can somehow undo the phony she's become...

Depressed and forced to work overtime, she accidentally discovers the one secret of the office's resident super manager, Shoji Kamijo! He offers to do anything for her, so long as she keeps quiet about it, so he has no choice but to do as she says! So, she asks him to pretend to be her boyfriend... 139099.description:
Wakaba Oda was a university student in art school when he first saw his artwork. “Kouta’s paintings have the power to make you long for them.” Wakaba’s admiration and shock jolted him strong enough for him to switch from being a painter, which he so dearly loved, to a graphic designer, which was still fulfilling and practical. Years pass, and Kouta, Wakaba, and Kouta’s twin brother Souta work together at the Ueda Gallery, the twins’ family business. The three make a great team, but only Souta can reel the two back when they get too lost within themselves, but he too may have his heart in the game… Perhaps it’s the artists inside them, but Kouta and Wakaba can never be as straightforward and honest with themselves with their words as they can with their paintings. So what are they trying to say when one has decided he won’t pick up a brush again and the other finds himself in an artist’s rut?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Motto Hideku Shite yo (もっと酷くしてよ, Hurt Me More)" and one extra chapter.

139102.description:
A collection of stories about the magic of love and the power it has by shining a light on those who have been cast aside. "There is Only One Person Behind Me": How does one even deal with their lover's body washed up on shore one day? Mr. Fujiwara goes through just that, but... is it his grief, or is he starting to see double? "A Bad Human": Mika and Asakawa met in university and clicked instantly. They had the same interests in music, humor, and hobbies. The one thing that they can't get in sync with is their daily schedules... "Cinderella.exe": In an MMO, you can make your avatar look exactly like yourself or not. Satou is a university student with the online persona of cute and powerful "Maria." Maria is married to the charming hero "Leonardo"... in the MMO. Will Satou ever be able to take things offline with his game-spouse? "In Search of Something That Can't Be Seen": Ren Kashiwagi is recruiting ghosts. He has been able to see them his entire life, and he is sick of being ridiculed and called a liar. Won't some kindhearted ghost come and save him from his woes!? Enter a human-like ghost that doesn't get on too well with his kind. He's willing to be captured to prove Ren's point, but first, Ren has to figure out this mystery ghost's identity! "Gold, Wheat, and His Reins": Yuusuke is content doing what he does. A part-time delivery truck driver and the occasional gig as a rope bondage artist. His hobby became his craft after a defining event in high school that made him want to escape, but what will he do when his past comes knocking at his door, or rather, he's knocking on its door? "The Vertex of a Triangle": In the omegaverse, alphas reign superior in all aspects of life. On the other hand, omegas are often used and manipulated to fit alphas' needs. That is exactly what is happening in front of Shima's (beta) eyes, who can barely handle it all. His boss Mr. Sakuraba (alpha) relies on him to do the dirty work, and the omegas, in particular, likes to tease and try to seduce him. On top of it all, there's something else going on behind Shima's back...

(Source: Futekiya)

But when she finds herself up against an immortal, silver-haired witch who promises to grant her wish, a new path leads her to the gods! Will she find freedom from her possession or is this only the beginning of something bigger?

Tomoru’s main concern is that he can’t satisfy, nor be satisfied by, his partner when they get intimate. Can Naru and Anji help Tomoru overcome his slump? He’s about to find out how inseparable these two really are. “Between Friends and Lovers”: Yukitada Senoo loves the idea of bromance and strongly wants a close guy friend himself. But being the socially awkward “Prince” of the school makes everything a little bit harder for him. Until he runs into Soujirou Hata, who looks like an actor, Senoo saw in a TV drama. This is his chance! Will Senoo be able to confess to Hata that he wants to be his boyfriend? Er, I mean… a friend that’s a boy?

Years pass by and the grown-up boy gets the name "Mu-Yeong," because he has no connection in the world, and grows up as a representative of Hyeopdo. However, unlike the master who insists on doing things for the suffering people without asking for anything in return, his only interest is to earn money and live on a remote island... Now 75 is on an epic quest to help the Demon King stay in power! To get there, 75 has to level up and conquer all his enemies, but if he doesn’t, this might just be his last life...

This man is actually Duke Leo Sirius Epesia, one of the most influential noblemen in the Floren Kingdom, and he seems to recognize her from 10 years ago. 139264.description:
"You are beautiful and kind... you are my mermaid."

Umi, a tattoo artist who carries a mermaid's curse, was born with a jet black right eye, and hid the right side of his body which carried an ugly birthmark from the curse. In order to hide this birthmark which even his parents despised, he covered it with a beautiful tattoo, and continued to live his life while hiding himself from the world. However, a chance encounter with a swindling spirit medium changed his life.

This is a once-in-a-lifetime love of a young man who was called a monster.

139268.description:
Michiru Tsukino's life is full of misfortune. The company she finally found a job at has gone bankrupt, and the friend she lent money to has run away.
In her grief, she runs to a shrine with all her money. The self-proclaimed god Ao appears and proposes to "bless" Michiru, but there are conditions...!

(Source: Comico, translated)

139270.description:
Growing up in Sakaiminato, Tottori Prefecture, Mizuki Shigeru often went to the Shimane Peninsula as a child. Guided by the words of a young man of the Izumo tribe who appeared to him in a dream, he traces the Mizuki roots to Oki and uncovers the grand mysteries hidden in Izumo mythology.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: La Guerra Del Riso E Del Ferro

139275.description:
Introverted high school student, Mugi, falls in love with his neighbor, Iyo, who always greets him kindly. One day, Mugi was kissed suddenly by Iyo, who has a different atmosphere than usual. Which is the real Iyo, was he a gentleman or a playboy? While visiting at Iyo’s place one night, Mugi learned that Iyo has a twin brother, Kiyo. While being groped all over by the rough Kiyo, Mugi was spoiled slowly with gentle kisses from Iyo…? The most erotic and cute 3P love is here!!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

139277.description: A female manhwa artist lives with her two adorable pets, a dog named Diend and a rabbit named Shuba. However, Diend's scary demeanor and over-protectiveness towards her owner leads others to believe she's dangerous and vicious.

139278.description: I share my personal experiences after living in France for several years. And this is not a success story if you think of it as one. It's a story of how I failed. Or is it??

139280.description:
In the new neighborhoods that sprung up in the countryside on the outskirts of Tokyo is Shinsei High School. Among the students is the young and restless Shingo Tamai, a first year student. At the beginning of the school year he presents the new coach of the soccer team, Tenpei Matsuki, whom was also a former goalkeeper of the Japanese national football and bronze medal winner at the Olympic Games in Mexico.
Matsuki intends to build a team that can compete at the highest levels. His intense workouts originally seems too much for many members of the team, including Shingo. He decides to boycott the team's "official" Matsuki team and creates his own. After a first victory, he is always defeated by that of Matsuki, which begins to be seen by Shingo as an invincible enemy.
Subsequently, the two will be able to clarify their conflicting relationship and Shingo will eventually become the captain of the only school team coached by Matsuki.

(Source: Wikipedia)

139281.description:
Eun Lee has had an eventful day. First, she won the lottery. Then, she was summoned to a mystical realm by the Demon King, Kaon Mahana Lord Moon Blood Rain, and was newly named Rue, princess of the demon realm. Eun demands to be returned to her original world so she can collect her winnings, but Kaon wonders if she has something to do with his late lover’s will. Eun surprises herself by adjusting to her new and unfamiliar life, but will she ever truly let go of her past and find happiness here?

(Source: Tapas)

139289.description:
A mysterious hereditary illness threatens 4 elites' lives. They'd do anything to cure it. But when fate takes them to a secret manor... Are they willing even to become slaves?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

139293.description:
How could Terryl’s boyfriend leave her simply because of her low status? After her humiliating breakup, a mysterious man tells Terryl the shocking truth about her identity—she’s the daughter of a powerful duke! With her advanced standing in society and newfound powers, Terryl plans revenge against her pitiful ex-boyfriend and contemplates marrying his brother, Cesio. This way, he’ll never get the title of marquis! But what will Terryl do when she discovers Cesio’s dark secret? Will she get her happily ever after, or is that just a fairytale?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 17 side story chapters.

シンデレラは私ではなかった

139298.description:
You’d think the ruler of the underworld would be more menacing than even a black bear.
But he has a secret and a cute hobby?!

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

139301.description:
At 33 years old, Asuka Miyazaki realizes that they like women! Asuka, however, is neither a woman nor a man–instead, they’re X-gender, which is a non-binary identity. Follow Asuka through the pages of this autobiographical manga as they record the ins and outs of their journey to finding love with a woman.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

139302.description:
Melt together, recall the memories, and do it all again.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Aoha 2019 Fuyu and Comic Aoha 2020 Haru

139305.description:
To others, I am a good-for-nothing. My mother-in-law doesn't like me because I live off my wife. In addition, there are a bunch of scums that are hungrily eyeing for my wife! Who said a live-in son-in-law can't soar high into the sky? I will protect Ji Xueyun from now on!

(Source: Webcomics)

139306.description:
A world dominated by a certain "strange law". When the hero and the demon king held hands, an angel with a beautiful face appeared. The angel tells a word to the hero. "You got half the world. There is a tax on the gift." So the "strange law" was the "tax" to God! The method taken by a brave man who was impatient with the extremely high gift tax on the huge assets of "half of the world" to escape tax payment. It was a fake marriage with the Demon King and relying on a girl. The girl is the survivor of "Zeirishi", the only phantom occupation that can compete with tax angels.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.romaji: Ken to Mahou no Zeikin Taisaku @comic
Ken to Mahou no Zeikin Taisaku

139308.description:
"I want to keep watching you grow..."

With the start of a new school year, Haruka starts high school and Shu starts his second year of junior high. It has been a year since Shu said he had something to tell Haruka once he had grown to the same height as him. The height difference is narrowing, and they are getting closer step by step...

(Source: Takeshobo)

Notes: Includes ten extra chapters.

139309.description:
Takeru Inomata is a high school student living in a small provincial town. Rumors, marriage, children, or things people'd rather leave unsaid... it all goes way over his head. He's just living a quiet life without trouble or passion, taking each day as it comes. That is, until a new student enrolls in his school. Takeru's surprised to discover that the newcomer is none other than Kotaro, one of his classmates from elementary school. Soon, the teenagers start getting closer to each other... Is it the beginning of a new love ?

(Source: Akata)

Sweaty Exercise with my mother-in-law and lover Mira, this time with patsupatsu wear ♪

With a face-sitting squat that emits a lewd incense, the two horny people reach climax! Shake your selfish body from below, from the front, and from the back to encourage an unhealthy diet ★

A collection of short stories never published before by the great master Mitsuru Adachi.
Daily life, mystery, sports and much more.

139322.description:
Laranora Ador gets more than she bargained for when she rescues a young boy from being sold off in an infamous auction house. The boy is actually Eskal Van Dyck, the "Crazy Marquess," in disguise! Unaware of his violent and heartless true nature, Laranora takes Eskal under her wing. Determined to raise him with utmost care and respect, Laranora grows deeply attached to Eskal… and in return, the true Eskal begins to fall in love with her. Unfortunately, Eskal is often targeted for his powerful magic and ruthless ways, which leads to a tragic event that separates the two. But Eskal is determined to find her again as his true self. Will Laranora be able to accept who he really is? And more importantly, what will happen when something fishy brewing in the Imperial Palace may involve them both?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: How To ดัดนิสัยมาร์ควิสจอมคลั่ง

139323.description:
“Onii-san, congratulations on your marriage. This person is your bride.” “M-my name is Watanae Yuuka… I’m in the same class as you…”

My name is Sakata Yuuichi. I’m in my 2nd year of high school. Due to my parents’ circumstances, I’m suddenly getting married..? Furthermore, my partner is a plain girl, Watanae-san.

During my 3rd year of middle school, I went through a bad experience. Ever since then, I’ve only been interested in 2D heroines. There’s absolutely no way I’d ever be interested in a 3D girl. That was what I thought, but…

“…Well then, who’s your favorite heroine right now?”

Turns out, she was actually an otaku and she becomes very talkative when you get to know her. She’d always happily engage in our conversations. She showed me things I’d never have expected from a girl in my class.

“Err, since we’re going to be living together… Is it okay if I call you Yuu-kun?”

And, the moment I let my guard down, she’d instantly try to shorten the distance between us. What’s more…

“Just between you and me, I’m actually the voice actress for Yuuna Izumi from 『Alice Stage』. Thank you for always supporting me!”

It’s a secret from everyone else, but it turns out she’s actually my favorite heroine’s voice actress?!

I am only interested in 2D heroines! But, Yuuka’s true self, which she only shows when she’s alone with me, is nothing but cute!

This is the story of me and Yuuka, starting as fiancees. A heartwarming and chaotic romcom!

139324.description:
Ryo spends his days pining after his handsome and kind-hearted colleague at work, Ninomiya. Ryo never admits his feelings, hiding them deep inside his heart. One night when his desire grows uncontrollable, he starts to touch himself, only to be interrupted by a... ghost!? And it seems that the poltergeist actually wants to help him finish the job! Ryo asks Ninomiya, who claims to be a psychic, to help him. For better or worse, the whole ordeal is about to change their relationship forever.

(Source: Renta!)

In the "mechanical girls" story, two high school girls discover a shabby machine in the back of a barn and it leads them to a strange world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

139330.description:
"You’re great just the way you are."

Even though Miku is 25 years old, she hasn’t learned a thing about how to do her own makeup -- but her boyfriend, Haru, tells her that he prefers her that way. Miku and Haru live together, after all, and they might get married, in which case she’ll just quit her job anyway, so it’s probably fine never to learn... At least, that’s what she tells herself. One day, a boy with a special love for makeup suddenly appears in her life. The beautiful stranger does Miku up gorgeously and Haru’s reaction to her new look is almost unbelievable--?

A story of starting anew and taking one’s life back through makeup!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

139333.description: In the year 20XX, a bill was passed to indentify and surveil every citizen using nanomachines and DNA data. Those who don't possess this identification are deemed criminals, "NoIDs". As disappearances continue in the city, Liu and Tough are living their lives as NoIDs in the slums, helping people find what they lost.

139334.description:
It was a time when idols brought hope to people.
Their radiance reaches even the youngest of boys.
A traumatized boy, Setsuna Sakura, happened to see an idol's live performance and was touched by the brilliance.
Longing to be an idol who is adored by others, Setsuna decided to audition for an idol agency to make his dream come true.
This is the story for those of us who want to shine as much as we can in our limited time.

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

139336.description:
He is a young general from a distinguished family; she is a married woman, betrayed countless times by her husband. The sinful relationship of a few years ago… The years of searching… And the reunion.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.native: 宠爱难逃:偏执顾少高冷妻

139337.description:
Detective Jung Seohun's got a new partner a strapping young academy graduate and detective on a fast-track to promotion, Detective Jang Haejoon. While Haejoon proves to be an observant, capable partner, he rubs Seohun the wrong way with his somewhat defiant, intrusive attitude. As they embark on a murder case together, will the two detectives get along? Will their free partnership prove to be something more than... a police partnership?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

139339.description:
When Princess Alisa is framed for a terrible crime, she is shocked to learn that her own family wants her executed. Feeling defeated, she finds herself reborn as the princess of a rival empire. And though her new family acts sweet and kind on the surface, she’s not sure they can be truly trusted. Luckily, with this new life comes new power. But what exactly is this mysterious magic that awakens in her? And more importantly, can she use it to get vengeance against those who once betrayed her?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Once Again Into the Light, Alone

139340.description:
Gyeoul, a friend from the same class, always maintains proper posture. For some reason, Gyeoul keeps catching Yohan's attention. Suddenly, the two of them become deskmates. Just like the physical distance, their hearts get closer. This loud heartbeat. What should we call the rising blush of that face? A clueless boy and girl's first love story.

(Source: Naver, translated)

139341.description:
I won't rest until they're dead.

Charlotte has no qualms about murder if it means her beloved Prince Albert can ascend to the throne. But when he accuses her of treason and leaves her to rot in prison, she learns that loyalty is no virtue. 5 years later, Count Kaitel appears before her with a request: “Won’t you kill the emperor?”

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: Why Would a Villainess Have Virtues?
Where Is Justice For the Villainess?
นางร้ายที่ไหนจะมีคุณธรรม

139343.description:
In the spicy novel "The Cursed Crown Prince," Prince Frederick is struck with a curse that causes him to switch bodies with any woman he spends the night with. This brings misfortune to the Chandler family, who is unfairly executed for treason when the royal physician, Cedric Chandler, fails to cure the prince. So the heroine knows she's in trouble when she wakes up as Irenia, the daughter of the Chandler family. Luckily, she also knows about the magic potion that can lift the curse, and seduces the cold Frederick to switch bodies with him. Once she feeds him the potion and gets her body back, "Irenia" thinks her problems are solved for good. But not long after she bids the prince goodbye, the two start switching bodies again at random times! And the only way for them to switch back is to spend the night with each other...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extra chapters
synonyms: คืนร้อน คำสาปรัก

139344.description:
What happens when a guy and a girl end up in an underground bunker together after the apocalypse? It seems like there’s only one inevitable answer when the Bongjoon finds himself locked in together with cute, curvy Hyun-mi for the rest of the foreseeable future. But things get complicated when sexy Nan-hee ends up joining them in the bunker with them. What happens when a guy ends up in an underground bunker with two busty babes? Bongjoon is about to find out the hard way!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 二人のイブ〜壁に閉じ込められた女〜

title.english: The Two Eves : The Girl Trapped in the Wall
title.romaji: Du Myeongui Eve: Byeoge Gachin Yeoja

139346.description:
A freshman from earth arrives at Andromeda High School, where troubled children from all over the universe gather.

The main character is the commander-in-chief. After passing through every high school on the planet due to the violence that erupts at each school he moves, he ends up transferring to Andro High School... In Andro High School, a wild jungle infested with psychic aliens, can he survive!? The goal is graduation! The captain's adventure begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

139347.description:
She's a human girl who became a spiritual fox. This little fox cultivates herself into a human, and slowly conquers the heart of a handsome man from the past! What's going on with that stern-faced Prince, anyway? He thinks our little fox friend eats too much and has gotten too chubby – but maybe that's his thing? That's ridiculous - she's got a temper too, you know! See how this modern girl, who was transformed into an imperial spiritual fox, cultivates herself to a higher level and stands tall as a fox spirit!

(Source: WebComics)

139349.description:
What, I transmigrated into a fox spirit? Stuck in the standard role as a foxy temptress! See how this fox cultivates herself into a goddess, and scoop up all the historically fine men along the way! But what's with this big-bad guy? He says that this baby fox eats too much and is going to get all fat and fleshy? How can he say things like that, foxes have feelings, too!! Let's see how the modern girl who transmigrated into the fox-spirit royalty will cultivate and upgrade herself to become top fox!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

139352.description:
Xia Weiyi's chivalrous dreamlover proposed to her obnoxious step-sister. In a pit of temper, Weiyi married her childhood sweetheart Gu Yiran - a decision she regretted to make immediately... "Gu Yiran, that was a mistake! I want a divorce!" "It's too late. Now that I've got a hold of you, I'll never let you go!" The girl who wanted to run away didn't expect that she would slowly fall into the sweep trap this scheming president wove.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.native: 暖婚撩人，顾少宠妻上瘾
title.romaji: Nuan Hun Liao Ren, Gushao Chong Qi Shangyin

139358.description:
Gakuon Otogami was a genius pianist whose name is among the greatest in the annals of the music world. He had seven children who also all became genius pianists. All seven except for the one named Lucky that is. This is the miraculous story of a regular kid taking on godly talent!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

139360.description: Leon is the kingdom's most worthless Court Magician. One day, his repeated absences are punished and he is sent to the battlefield, but with the quick wits he was hiding he saved the Third Princess Sicily? Then, along with the reformer princess, and steeling his own resolve, Leon becomes a specialized officer determined to control events from the shadows.
synonyms: The Court Wizard in the Shadows

title.native: 影の宮廷魔術師～無能だと思われていた男、実は最強の軍師だった～
title.romaji: Kage no Kyoutei Majutsushi: Munou da to Omowareteita Otoko, Jitsu wa Saikyou no Gunshi datta

139361.description:
With a bouquet, wearing suits and cool...woman!? ---Hikaru Kasuga, a poor student, meets Aya Sumino at his new part time job. A sweet talker who loves suits and wears them just as well; she is a woman with masculine appeal. Although just boss and employee, the unusual closeness they share takes Hikaru for a ride from beginning to end as he is unable to keep up with his heart. It can't be romantic... but she's coming on to me! A classic romantic comedy of unset boundaries that'll keep you on the edge of your seat.

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: My boss's pressure is too strong to love

title.english: Too Overwhelmed By My Boss To Fall In Love
title.native: 上司の圧が強すぎて恋ができない
title.romaji: Joushi no Atsu ga Tsuyo Sugite Koi ga Dekinai

139362.description:
Hirata, the class's introvert committee chairman, is actually "Jackie," a famous video game streamer. On the other hand, Saionji-san, the most beautiful girl in school, is actually a big fan of Jackie...⁉ If she finds out who Jackie really is, her interest will surely end immediately!

(Source: MangaCross, translated)

Note: Includes one bonus chapter.

title.native: 平田君、声だけめちゃくちゃ愛してる

139364.description:
The French Revolution, starting with the king, sent many citizens to the guillotine, "exporting" the momentum of democratization to countries around the world—marking a turning point in history. But underneath the surface, there was another world that none were aware of...

18th century France—this was a time where the world's royalty, nobility, and commoners were separated into a 3-tier system, α (alpha), β (beta), and Ω (omega).

King Louis XVI was known as the "dim-witted alpha." Queen Marie Antoinette, who came from a neighboring country in a political marriage, was ridiculed as the "lustful omega." And then there was another "girl," who resented the royal family…

Desire, hate, and deception… All of them will be caught up in a whirlwind of intrigue, amidst the oncoming storm of revolution…!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 殉国のアルファ～オメガ・ベルサイユ～

139368.description: <i>Note: It was never finished due to the sudden death of it's mangaka Takaki Konari.<i>

139370.description:
Sarasa, a newly graduated state alchemist, has been gifted a shop of her very own by her master. The catch is...it’s an abandoned building on the frontier! She sets out on the journey there, dreaming of the elegant life that awaits her as a shop owner, but she’s quickly disappointed to learn just how much of a fixer-upper the place really is. Still, even if she’s not thrilled with the rustic location, she’s got a shop to run or she won’t be able to make a living! Surrounded by cute part-timers and kindly villagers, Sarasa is determined to stand on her own as an alchemist. This laid-back story of a magical work life is now open for business!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: 新米錬金術師の店舗経営

139371.description: The one-shot follows "Spiritsetter" Fujiwara and his assistant Sadako; who quell lingering ghosts with the help of Fujiwara's psychic ability to see spirits.

139372.description:
A security breach rocks the office of kingpin Hasegawa: a young hacker known only as Shuu stole sensitive client information for nefarious purposes! But when Shuu says, "I'm sorry, I won't do it again," and then tries to leave, Hasegawa decides to teach him the difference between the two of their social standings through sex. When Shuu wakes up, he is told, "I've decided to keep you." What does Hasegawa have in store for him!?

A yakuza who struggles to be ruthless x a young hacker who can't remember people's faces are trapped in a love affair that can't be broken free from. Which one of them is really trapped?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: パーフェクト・エデュケーション

139373.description:
During the holidays, Mo Bai and his older brother Mo Fan were attacked by a zombeast that broke into their house. After the attack, Mo Bai found himself turning into a zombeast, while Mo Fan was rescued by the zombie-hunters. To find his brother, Mo Fan became the strongest hunter in the organization. People were frightened when Mo Bai reappeared as an S-rank zombeast. Now the brothers will finally meet again, but the situation is completely different, and they are on the edge of an explosive conflict.

(Source: MKZhan, translated)

139374.description:
1. Sukoshi wa Ganbare! Meina-chan (すこしはがんばれ! めいなちゃん, Put in some effort, Meina-chan!); Comic ExE 19

These gates brought on many new changes including the birth of heroes called “hunters” who could fight back the monsters that came out of the gates. However, because these hunters were specially chosen by transcendent beings called “sponsors,” the hunters began to call themselves “gods” and organized a new world order called “Eden.” Unfortunately, the people who were not chosen became slaves to the hunters and these self-proclaimed gods. Now, in the present, Junkyung Lee, a powerless ordinary person, is training hard so that he can get sponsored to be a hunter. However, in the middle of his training, he and his mentor, Sungkoo, suddenly get attacked by the ruler of Eden. Before Junkyung gets killed, Sungkoo manages to send Junkyung back a hundred years into the past with the task of changing the course of history and the fabric of society.

Adel never intended to make her living at the card tables of casinos, but as an orphan with few other talents, her gift for gambling was too valuable to pass up. (Source: MANGA UP!)
synonyms: คู่หูคู่ศัตรา

139487.description:
I'm spending Christmas night alone with a beautiful older woman from the neighborhood. It would be a dream come true for most boys, if she weren't totally drunk.
"Hey, kid, can you get me some snacks?"
This is the story of Izumi Nanase, an unbelievably beautiful woman who is a carefree slacker. She comes to my house without permission, she likes to drink, she teases me whenever she can, and she's just a pain in the ass. I don't care how great she looks, having a neighbor who bosses me around like a little brother is a nightmare.

It's a love comedy about a high school boy and a bad girl with a good face but no self-awareness. A heroine who specializes in drinking at home!

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

139488.description:
The older brother was a genius. At just 15 years old, he was already receiving offers from top teams around the world — a true “treasure of Japanese soccer.” Would it be Madrid or Barcelona? Or perhaps a prestigious club in England? The entire country was watching with anticipation to see where he would go.
But the young prodigy made a surprising choice: he decided to attend “a Japanese high school where his underachieving younger brother would be enrolling.”
“Because there’s someone amazing there that I want to play with!”
With the “genius older brother” and the “underachieving younger brother,” let them stir up a storm in the world of soccer!

(Source: Magazine pocket)
synonyms: Dye Blue, Even If You Die

139489.description:
Sarasa is an orphan girl who just graduated from the royal alchemist training school. Having received an isolated shop as a gift from her teacher, she embarks on the leisurely life she long dreamt of as a alchemist. However, what awaits her is a shop more decrepit than she ever imagined, out in the boondocks. As she gathers ingredients, trains herself, and sells goods to become an upstanding alchemist, she tries to lead her very own slow, relaxed alchemist life.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 新米錬金術師の店舗経営

139491.description:
Kouda Emi, an almost-thirty OL who has the worst luck with men, got drunk at a company party and was put in the care of Shota Furukawa (26), the most handsome kouhai at the company. Shota's self-control reaches its limit when he saw Emi in such a defenseless state. He made her come over and over again with intimate and intense caresses...
"You're so beautiful."
Why does he hold her so lovingly, as if he loved her?
The girl with the worst luck with men finally gets pampered to the max in this doting love story!

(Source: Libre, translated)

title.native: 黙って僕に甘やかされて ～相性いいのはカラダだけ？～
title.romaji: Damatte Boku ni Amayakasarete: Aishou ii no wa Karada dake?

139492.description:
With the power of his right arm, the main character, Woo Su-Kwang, who has always been good at fighting and overpowers the best at each school he attends, is a legend among his high school peers. However, his wish is to live an ordinary life just like everyone else.

Then, by chance, he met the head teacher, Park Su-Ho, and it turns out that he was an exorcist. He said he would teach Su-Kwang how to control his right arm. The condition is that he joins the exorcism club.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

139493.description:
Based on the Sega Saturn game by the same name.

Note: Released as Enix Supercomic Gekijoh Volume 11
synonyms: Super Comic Gekijou: Langrisser 5 - The End of Legend
Langrisser V: The End of Legend
スーパーコミック劇場 ラングリッサー5―ジ エンド オブ レジェンド

title.native: ラングリッサー5―ジ エンド オブ レジェンド

139494.description:
A short series about a girl who misses school for one day.

Winner of the Nakayoshi x Comici Short Series Prize. First published online, it was serialized in the 2020/10 issue of Nakayoshi (digital version).

139495.description:
The new transfert student is an alpaca !

Winner of the Nakayoshi x Comici Short Series Prize. First published online, it was serialized in the 2020/10 issue of Nakayoshi.

title.native: もふもふ男子 アル川パカ之助くん

139496.description:
This is the story of a girl who was offered to the Lord of the Forest.

Winner of the Nakayoshi x Comici Short Series Prize. First published online, it was serialized in the 2020/10 issue of Nakayoshi (digital version).

title.native: わしの所に来たイケニエがなんだかおかしい
title.romaji: Washi no Tokoro ni Kita Ikenie ga Nan da ka Okashii

139497.description:
Things are finally looking up for aspiring actress Bobae Lee, after her appearance on the hit matchmaking Reality TV show, “The Aftermath”. But when her co-star suddenly commits suicide, everything slowly begins to crumble as Bobae soon finds herself the new target of public hate. As she works to rebuild her career from the ground up, she quickly learns that fame can be a double-edged sword and that sometimes, the people closest to you can end up hurting you the most.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

139499.description:
In the Edo era, young Jinta and his sister must flee their home, finding refuge in a mountain village. Years later, Jinta has grown into a skilled swordsman, sworn to protect the priestess of the village shrine. Charged with slaying a demon that threatens the shrine, Jinta confronts the malevolent creature in the forest, only to learn a shocking truth. The demon speaks of events one hundred and seventy years hence, when Jinta must confront the demon in the future. Thus begins an epic fantasy journey that spans multiple eras as Jinta hunts a demon through time and must come to terms with his own dark nature.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Sword of the Demon Hunter: Kijin Gentosho

139500.description:
Noah's classmates can't even be bothered by him in real life, but inside the Interverse, he's the celebrated number one player. He may be applauded as a genius in-game, but the real world remains a cruel place for Noah... that is until he beats the school bully in an Interverse tournament. His talents are recognized by a mysterious professor who recruits him into an elite academy. As reality and the game world blur together, will Noah be able to make a stand for himself and challenge all expectations?

(Source: Tapas)

139501.description:
The laws of the world have changed!

In an instant, the world turned into a hell for the strong because of the god Kashita. At the end of the slaughter test given by the gods, Yu Do-Hyeok became the “Great Emperor”, the strongest of mankind, and defeated God.

However, the pleasure of victory is short-lived, and everyone returns to the first day of the trial with their memories of what happened. With the exception of Yu Do-Hyeok.

Instead of helping each other, people rush to take the place of the strongest one by killing the Great Emperor. In a world crazier than his previous life, can Yu Do-Hyeok kill God and restore peace?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

139502.description: An anthology of short stories drawn by Shuuhou Itahashi between 1981 and 1984.
synonyms: エイリアン・クラッシュ

title.native: エイリアンクラッシュ

139503.description:
When Suh volunteered as a beta tester for a cutting-edge ultra VR game, he never imagined he'd be stuck there for the next 20 years. It was only after he finally died in the game he managed to "log off" from the game… only to realize five years have passed in real-life. Reality seemed a lot harsher than the game world he had left, as his family went broke having to pay his hospital bills all those years he lay in bed in a coma while stuck in the game. Pressed by loansharks, Suh decides to turn to what he does best... and logs back into the game, hoping to make enough money in the gaming world to convert it into real life currency and pay off the debt. To his pleasant surprise, Suh discovers that he gets to keep most of what he learned over 20 years of being stuck in the previous version of the game! This should be pretty easy... right?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

139504.description: The special discipleship of Mu-Rim's best assassin, Gwi-Myeon-Dok, will begin.
synonyms: ひ弱先生〜気弱な先生は

139508.description:
A young girl hides her talents for English during classes.

Winner of the Nakayoshi x Comici Short Series Prize. First published online, it was serialized in the 2020/10 issue of Nakayoshi

title.romaji: I Don't Like You no Imi

139509.description: Food can be full of memories.

139513.description:
Twenty-year-old college student Eichi Usagi was out for a night on the town when he got caught up with a street hustler. He is taken to a mysterious club "Owl Night" which seems to cater to both men and women...?

(Source: Monthly Shounen Gangan, translated)

139514.description: Yamato is a small country at war with the military might of Mars. In the face of this overwhelming superiority, Yamato's defeat seems inevitable. Even on the island of Gallé in the South Pacific Ocean, where fierce battles are also being fought, Yamato's army is in a state of collapse. Sergeant Tatsumi fights for the survival of his regiment, which is in a desperate situation. One day, just when all hope seems to be gone, he sees an "object" named Kitetsu drop from a transport plane...

139515.description:
What is telencephalon? If one were to derive the surface meaning of the word, telecephalon is a living organ made up of both the left and right brains. In this story, it will be used to describe the universal conflict within the grand scheme that we call telecephalon cosmo. The story begins with a mysterious murder that progresses to reveal the secrets of the entire universe. From dark conspiracies to galactic warfare, from inhumane betrayal to noble sacrifices, humanity have never understood how pitiful and weak they are as they make one final desperate struggle against fate...

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

139517.description:
Fujii and Yoshimi have promised to marry, but a harsh fate befalls them.
What do they see as they live their lives to the fullest...?
This is the ultimate romance comic that tells the weight and fragility of happiness with the wind in the air.

This is a complete manga adaptation from the same-name novel.

(Source: Shougakukan, translated and adapted)

139519.description:
Haru, who is worried about the direction his modeling agency is taking, sympathizes with Sakuya’s straightforward feelings for cats and gradually becomes attracted to him. This is the story of Sakuya Furukawa, a cat lover, and Haru Koizumi, a famous model.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 猫に捧げるカーテンコール
メリー・マリー・ゴールド

139521.description: Blue Dragon, Red Phoenix, White Tiger, and Black Tortoise. To stop the sacred spirits of the Heavenly Realm wreaking havoc in the world of humans, successors of the Four Deities are born in each generation to guard the barrier of the Heavenly Realm, using the powers of the four sacred spirits. And the place they gather to train before they ascend to heaven is Doonggule, a traditional tea house in a small country

139522.description:
Kim Pyeong-Beom is an ordinary person who lives a common life, but one day an alien with the appearance of a teddy bear lands in his room! From that moment on, he will accept that intercultural exchange with BR, the fifth prince of Planet KKRY… But how will he end up becoming the prince's sex education manager too?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

139526.description: Ayu Shirakawa, who has run away from home. Through her cousin Miyako, Ayu is introduced to the author Yukari Ebiwara (penname Hikari Kairou), and starts a part time job as her caretaker. Yukari often slacks off by playing games and going on trips, but Ayu really enjoys her new everyday life. And as the two live together and grow closer, Ayu starts to have feelings she never had before.

title.romaji: Shimekiri Mae ni wa Yuri ga Hakadoru

synonyms: みき&ユーティシリーズ
みき&ユーティシリーズ

139532.description:
Tanabe and Kouno from Hyuga, Miyazaki, both are accepted to attend "Seventh High School," one of the most prestigious schools under the old education system. What the two freshmen did not expect, though, was the bandit-like peers in the older classes. Tanabe and Kouno must fight to protect themselves from the ruthless attempts of the upperclassmen and ensure they all come out in one piece. (Warning: Rape)

(Source: Futekiya)

139533.description:
Alone at work late at night...A banquet of debauchery begins!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2021-06

139534.description:
Same old life...same old fear...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2021-09

139536.description:
In a dwelling on the roof of a public bathhouse, crocodile “Gera Gera” gets waken up by his human housemate, his self-professed lover Ikkoku. They work for the Public Works and Construction of Viva City, the one dark shadow in the popular tourist planet Dyna Blue. When Mayor Celdy commissions them for a job to deactivate the core of a prehistoric military facility, is there anything they should be looking out for underground in particular? And how much are they even going to get paid for this!?

(Source: Futekiya)

139537.description:
Narasaki and Terashima never thought they would ever make a perfect match, but now that they are, how has their relationship progressed through high school and to the apartment they share as college students? A collection of side stories from the original "Blue Sky Complex", showing what happens after Narasaki and Terashima walk out of the school library - and straight into the bedroom!

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: ブルースカイコンプレックス番外編 インディゴブルーのグラデーション
title.romaji: Blue Sky Complex Bangai-hen: Indigo Blue no Gradation

139538.description:
After committing numerous unforgivable acts of violence, the town decides to exile Bromei. The town priest says this was all due to his unlucky birth, his family said he should have never been born, and the town calls him a demon, but here in the Isle of Trees, can he finally be free of all these restraints? What kind of life can he find together with the mysterious army doctor, Fiance?

(Source: Futekiya)

139539.description:
On a ravage planet awakens the ""goddess"" Artesia Gaia Nagasus, a vestige of a long forgotten ancient civilization. Artesia's grand plan: lead the nascent humanity to produce a ""hero,"" whom she'll coach in his quest to defeat the evil lord. Then maybe she'll shed her divinity and enjoy the life of a beloved woman... But just as Artesia finishes dreaming of this cliche manga goddess trope, she realizes there's one problem... She woke up too early! Will Artesia manage to weather hundreds of thousands of years by herself until humanity can arise again? And does she really have what it takes to lead humanity to glory... or will she let her more base instincts foil it all?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.
synonyms: Defective Goddess' Genesis of Another World

title.english: A Clumsy Goddess's Whole New Universe
title.native: ポンコツ女神の異世界創世録

139540.description:
This is the story of a loving couple, Subaru and Chika Takahashi.

(Source: Comic Action, translated)
synonyms: My Wife Whom I Loved Dearly

139542.description: This is an anthology of short stories based on the Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan series
synonyms: Rohan Kishibe Does Not Frolic: Short Story Collection

title.native: 岸辺露伴は戯れない 短編 小説集
title.romaji: Kishibe Rohan wa Jarenai: Tanpen Shousetsu-shuu

title.native: 帰る家には恋がいない
title.romaji: Kaeru Ie ni wa Koi ga Inai

139545.description: The care and feeding of a human-cat.

title.romaji: Ren Xing Miao De Yang Cheng

139546.description:
In the hospital convenience store, the blind Bai Xiaoxiao met a girl who smelled of sweets. Their story unfolds in the hospital filled with the scent of disinfectant, as they become dear and help to heal each other.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: キャンディ ふたりの約束

139547.description:
Gu Yun returned to his hometown in order to fulfill his father's last wish. During an assassination attempt from the Lucas family, he ran into a childhood friend Lu Yihan. One thing led to another and Gu Yun found himself entangled with Lu Yihan. After over coming all the hardships , the two become close confidants.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

139548.description:
No one could guess that the two largest companies in town are run by a werewolf and a vampire, who also happen to be childhood friends. The werewolf has loved the vampire since forever, and to take their relationship to the next level, he volunteers to be an assistant slash slave to the vampire. And that's how their love story begins...

(Source: WebComics)

139549.description:
King of the silver screen, Ye Changshi, was diagnosed with stomach cancer at the peak of his career. Unexpectedly, he transmigrated into another world into a younger version of himself. But upon arrival, he found himself in the bathtub with a hunk, Ji Ling!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

139550.description:
Legend has it that a man with black hair and red eyes will bring ruin to Den Helder's royal family. Because he was born with these features, Rayton is shunned by the palace as "the cursed one." When the vengeful prince stages a bloody coup detat years later, the powerless youngest princess, Setz, also dies by his sword. Little does Setz know that she's about to wake up in her body five years in the past-- but now that she has, it's her chance to get on Rayton's good side and turn her fate around. Cracking the prince's cold exterior is a challenge, but once she does, there seems to be no going back! As Rayton grows more and more attached to her, Setz is pulled deeper into the midst of the dark conspiracies brewing around the palace. Has the princess truly escaped death, or is she in more danger than ever before?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters
synonyms: Boukun no Aichaku Ningyou (暴君の愛着人形)

139551.description: Fuck... if you show me such a cute sleeping face, I won’t be able to let you sleep anymore...!
synonyms: Let Me Sleep With You, Haruomi-kun!

title.english: Let Me Sleep with You, Haruomi!
title.native: 晴臣くん､抱かせてください!

139552.description:
Life is rough enough for a struggling young actor, but Yeon-O has bigger problems at home with his gambling addict of a father. Between barely finding any work and constantly getting hounded by unsavory loan sharks, Yeon-O finds himself reluctantly accepting a dangerous offer from a dangerous man...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

139553.description:
Regen Hagart discovers her dead genius Royal alchemist aunt's recipe of the Dream Potion which allows the contractor to enter the drinker's dream. Hoping to hold her crush, Daniel's hands at least in her dreams, Regen creates the potion. However, Kaiden Roose, her long time Royal Academy rival accidentally ends up drinking the potion. The effect of the potion was suppose to last for one dream but Regen keeps on entering and appearing in Kaiden's dreams. What will happen to these two?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: 翻车了! 似乎要和死对头组CP

139554.description:
Jong-Hyeon is your average college student with a crush on a girl who’s dating somebody else. The fact that the guy she’s dating is a total jerk is just salt on the wound. Meanwhile, his classmate Seo-Jin happens to have a crush on that total jerk. After sharing drinks and sob stories, the two of them end up having sex. That’s not a big deal. The big deal is the scheme that Seo-Jin proposes to him to get their respective crushes to break up. It might be the worst idea ever, but it’s an offer that he can’t refuse…

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)

synonyms: The Strongest Warlord Goes to School

139556.description:
Ages ago in a land of myth and legend, a young girl called Rose stands tied to a stake, awaiting her cruel fate as a sacrifice to the sea serpent known as Leviathan. That is, until a dashing hero suddenly appears to defeat the monster and save Rose’s life. Eternally grateful, Rose becomes devoted to her rescuer Mikhail, who is the demigod son of the moon goddess, Diana. She joins his party of adventurers, but soon comes to realize that her savior may not be as noble as he seems…

(Source: Webtoons)
synonyms: To You Who Do Not Love Me
To You Who Never Loved Me
Para el que nunca me amó
To You Who Doesn't Love Me
ถึงท่านที่ไม่รักกัน
To You Who Don't Love Me
私を愛してくれないあなたへ

title.english: To You Who Doesn't Love Me

139557.description:
An adult action fantasy set in the world view of Dante's Divine Comedy.

(Source: Namu, translated & edited)

139558.description:
I found someone who looks exactly like me on SNS! He seems to have everything unlike me who grew up in an orphanage. Maybe he could be my twin?! When I was about to find him and solve my life problems, I got into huge trouble!!

(Source: YLAB)

Note: Belongs to Blue String universe.

139559.description:
1. Totsugeki Tonari no Ban Okazu! (突撃となりの晩おかず！, Late Night Neighbor Okazu Squad!); 2015-04
2. Idol ni Naru mon! (アイドルになるもん！, I'll become an Idol! ); 2015-11
3. Otona Burikko (大人ぶりっこ, Playing Innocent ); 2015-08
4-6. Sanbiki ga Yuku! (三匹がゆくっ！, The Three Girls Go!); 2016-04, 05, 08
7. Nana no Ana♥ (ナナノアナ♥); Comic Purumelo 2014-11
8. Himesama ni Goyoujin (姫様にご用心); Comic Purumelo 2014-09
9. Look at me!; Comic Purumelo 2014-06

Note: Includes bonus chapters from the Melonbooks and Toranoana stores:

10. Sanbiki ga Yuku! After (三匹がゆくっ！アフター, The Three Girls Go! After); Melonbooks Kounyu Tokuten
10. Zoku Totsugeki Tonari no Ban Okazu! (続・突撃となりの晩おかず！); Toranoana Kounyu Tokuten

139560.description: A collection of Tatsunoko's one-shots/standalone comics.

title.native: 短編集Memories タツノコマンガまとめ

139561.description:
Lee Yu-Ri studies as the successor of the incense shop, her family's business has been passed down from generation to generation. She rejected the love of her smug classmate, but ends up being bullied by the boy's gang at school. One day, she was running away from the man who was bothering her and went to the mountain. But suddenly a tin fell from the sky and hit Yu-Ri's head which killed her immediately. Yu-Ri thought she was dead, but when she opened her eyes, she was already on the lap of a handsome man named So-Woo! And the man called her Lady.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

synonyms: The Morning Train Next to the Person I Like

title.native: 朝電車で好きな人と隣になった話
title.romaji: Asa Densha de Suki na Hito to Tonari ni natta Hanashi

139566.description: A spin off for J no Subete, 15 years later.
synonyms: J no Subete Spin Off: Piece

title.native: piece Jの総てアナザーストーリーズ
title.romaji: piece: J no subete Another Story

139567.description:
What kind of loser can't get into a single college? Well, one guy knows the feeling. But hey, chin up dude. Your older brother is letting you manage a share house full of college girls. Maybe things aren't as bad as they seem?

(Source: DAYcomics)

139568.description:
Vivian Louis is the twenty-one-year-old daughter of a Count, a sweet and seemingly harmless girl who has only one guilty pleasure in life: thirsting after her crush, the breathtakingly handsome Grand Duke Lennox Elphidion Glenn! For her, it was love at first sight at the tender age of fourteen. That’s when she began obsessing over him, creating endless works of fan art and fan fiction. Then one day, an accident with her best friend’s magical crystal ball makes the unthinkable come true. The grand duke is kidnapped and tied up in her bed, and he’s telling her that she’s the kidnapper! Scrambling for a way out of this scandalous bind, the two agree to act like a couple. They even sign a one-year contract, but Lennox seems to want more than a fake relationship. Unbeknownst to Vivian, a full-blown romance is on its way. Could it be that her wildest fan fantasies will truly come to life?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Grand Duke, It Was a Mistake!
แกรนด์ดยุกขา อย่าถือสาข้าเลย

title.english: It Was a Mistake, Grand Duke!

139569.description:
A two-dad parenting team!
Doting father Sung-Sil suddenly discovers his wife is a gangster and their son isn't actually his! The real father, actor Seung-Heon Kang, reclaims his child but soon realizes he can't handle the constant wailing. Can these two men find a way to work together and raise little Hyun-Woo?

(Source: Manta)

title.romaji: Liang Ge Baba Yi Ge Wa

139571.description:
Bonny and Mickey are young and in love, but Mickey is married to the life of a long-haul trucker. Though they have a son together, the gulf between the two grows with each broken promise and passing year, until all that’s left are small mementos, postcards, and memories. After a naïve, pure-hearted young man enters their orbit, things slowly begin to change…

(Source: Glacier Bay Books)

title.native: トゥルーブルーは決して色あせない
title.romaji: True Blue wa Kesshite Iro Asenai

139572.description:
Seong-Woo is a former special forces soldier who has returned to college after completing his national service. His ordinary life as a student is shattered during class one day when he and his fellow students are faced with a mysterious prompt asking them to “select a role.” Seongwu chooses the necromancer, a rare ability that grants him the power to control the undead. With the campus and outside world seemingly on the brink of collapse, Seong-Woo must use his newfound powers to battle fearsome monsters and help save his fellow students. But will they make it out alive?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

139573.description:
Jaerim Lee, a student in film studies major, needed a way to quiet down the rumors that he's into guys. Gaeun Cha, a student in screenwriting major, needed to get away from the dorky senior who was always hitting on her. The two of them begin a contractual relationship to solve their problems, but as they get to know each other, Gaeun starts to fall for Jaerim’s charm little by little...

(Source: WEBTOON)

139574.description:
Ihn Kim is an explosive Taekwondo fighter who can throw brutal kicks, but his opponents don’t take him seriously because he’s held back by all the sparring rules. However, changes are coming in the Taekwondo world that just might give Ihn a fighting chance. Can Ihn beat the people who once mocked him and show everyone that his style of Taekwondo is no joke?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

139575.description:
A series of crimes based on fairytales.

A murderer by the alias “The Tale” is on the loose, and he uses fairytales to manipulate others into kidnapping and killing his victims for him. Five missing women. Five mysterious invitations. One party. Will the unlikely duo of elite detective and playful author be able to work around their differences to get to the bottom of the case?

(Source: Manta)

139576.description:
Stories of their last days.

I work at a nursing home, taking care of elders living their last days. I deal with their childish tantrums and shed tears as I listen to their life stories. They constantly amaze me with their insights, and most importantly, they remind me of the value of life.

(Source: Manta)

139578.description: We are in the States - Michelle is a prostitute with a child picks clients every day on the streets, while Chris, her teenager husband and the father of the baby, babysits. This is the story of their aimless days. A masterpiece about the joys and sorrows of love.

title.native: モンキーピーク the Rock

139581.description:
Does love really last forever?

College student Izzy Noh thinks her loving relationship with her boyfriend Minsu will last forever… until he cheats on her. To make things worse, they are not only in the same school, but in the same Game Developer Club. Izzy must now navigate handling the breakup, dealing with her feelings, and possibly opening up to another shot at love. Will Izzy and her friends from the Game Developer Club find true campus love?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: As If You've Never Been Hurt
As If I've Never Been Hurt

139582.description:
1. Dear Diary (ディア・ダイアリー)
2. Polaris
3. Ana Clift (アナ・クリフト)
4. Tenshun (転瞬)
5. MIAMI
6. the bridegroom
7. Tada Yumi making scene (多田由美 making scene)
synonyms: ディア・ダイアリー - 多田由美 短編集

139583.description:
The fate of a girl in a BL novel is a tragic one. Girls are either vaguely helpful, evil, or add nothing to the plot. So what happens when you turn into the older sister of a BL novel protagonist? The older sister who dies a tragic death at the hands of a madman who’s infatuated with your younger brother? You go with your gut instinct: hide him. Hide your brother from everything, especially men, that could harm him and you. That’s the task that Kyla Vesta is set with in this life, and a task that she’s determined to complete.

(Source: Lezhin)
synonyms: First Let's Hide My Younger Brother
Let’s Hide My Younger Brother First
Pas touche à mon petit Frère!

139584.description:
A poor young man has no choice but to work in construction for some extra cash. However, he didn't expect romance in a place like this!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

139585.description:
If you see a lucky dolphin, your unrequited love will be reciprocated. That's the legend around these parts. Natsume Shirahama was just having a laugh at the old superstition when a cute girl Umika appeared in front of him wearing a dolphin ornament in her hair. Surely a hair ornament doesn't have anything to do with that, he thought.

"I thought if I waited here, I might be able to see Natsume-kun again."

Actually he was still pining for Hirose Haru, his old crush, who moved away to Tokyo for college. But as he played with Umika and helped her with her studies, it was almost like old times, except this time it was like his unrequited love was being rewarded.

"Sometimes, you look just like Seitarou-senpai."

It looks like Shirahama isn't the only one who's trying to get over an old crush?

(Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Let me forget my first love

title.native: 忘れさせてよ、後輩くん。

139590.description: A young king who lost his mother just after she gave birth to him... wants to know what kind of person his mother was. He makes a pact with a what he believes to be a Djinn... but is actually a demon wishing to consume his "essence."

139591.description:
A railway accident changed Qiancheng's life... Having always looked up to his deceased brother Qianqing, he applied to a special agency for an intelligent creature ── RE614. How will this creature, with the same appearance as his brother, impact Qiancheng's life?

(Source: Tongli, translated)

title.native: カミジョーさんは食いしん坊

139594.description:
Atsufumi is a performer for a membership-based show for sex. Atsufumi is excited to be popular, but is provoked by Mitsuki, another performer skilled in technique and control, who says his popularity is only because he is new. Atsufumi will not have such slander, and proclaims that he will make Mitsuki drop to his knees in pleasure. The two continue to bicker like an old couple… and continue to be paired up with each other for special events like the Sweetheart Play event! Will Mitsuki and Atsufumi be able to pull off a lovey-dovey act when they’re both determined to make each other cry? “Succubus Brothers’ Extreme Lesson ❤︎”: Their job as a male succubus is to squeeze out the human male’s semen. Will one older brother be able to teach his ambitious younger brother his ways as a successful succubus? “Ninja in Distress”: Soryu’s master, the Head of the Sakaida family, has been defeated. And just as the now-rogue ninja Soryu is trying to figure out how he can follow through on his mission, he is captured by none other than his master’s rival, Hitonari the Lord of Nyudo. Will Soryu be condemned to a treacherous fate, or will he find his new master and mission? (Warning: Rape)

(Source: Futekiya)

139595.description:
Masumi Kubota is a university student with delusions of grandeur. On his twentieth birthday, he tries drinking for the first time, because he thinks that drinking strong alcohol is degenerate and cool. But he's gone after half a can and blacks out! His neighbor, Mio, who goes to the same university as him, takes him in. Mio doesn't get drunk from alcohol, but he does get drunk from certain physical activities. Masumi is so jealous of his ability to stay sober that he ends up sleeping with him...!? Mio, the mysterious, alcohol-immune prodigy in bed, decides to help Masumi, the delusional lightweight who turns really cute when he's drunk. Will their drinking practice that leads to consensual drunken encounters develop into love!?

(Source: Renta!)

139596.description:
The manga centers on Tsumugi, who isn't good at socializing with others, when suddenly she moves and ends up becoming a freeloader at the house of a manga artist named Ryoutarou.

(Source: Anime News Network)

139598.description: A catastrophe known as “Data Crash” struck the earth in 2020. Survivors rule the game, and losers are erased. Jacob Wei, a senior player, happened to fail despite surviving many rounds. Surprisingly, he was taken back to the beginning of the crash and was reborn with the incredible Self-Destruction System. Now he earns points from his stupid acts, triggering self-destruction in order to be reborn. Each revival makes him stronger. Thus unfolds the story about how he starts over and makes his way to the top.

139599.description: A shut-in aspiring author bumps into a runaway "love doll" on one of his nightly walks.

139600.description:
Marunouchi-kun's new alien classmate was supposed to be a super fantastic alien, but...

A story about a yandere alien and a boy who is interested in ONLY aliens

139601.description:
Nanase Izumi is unbelievably beautiful, yet so carefree and oblivious that it almost cancels out her looks. Ever since an unfortunate (and drunken) Christmas Eve meeting, a certain high school boy has found her showing up at his place unannounced. If drinking like a fish breathes water wasn’t enough, she has zero sense of boundaries and is always teasing her younger neighbor-slash-unwilling host. Careless meets clueless in this rom-com about a drop-dead gorgeous but hopelessly messy home-drinker and the high school boy who keeps getting dragged into her antics.

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

139602.description:
For centuries he has lived in secret and under different names just to find a cure for what has turned him into a vampire — the plague. Until one day, she finds out about him being a vampire. What is she going to do? Will she still love him despite everything?

(Source: WebComics)

139603.description:
A gap-comedy about delinquent boys who love girl x girl manga!

139604.description:
In a world where people suddenly developed super-powers, those who used their abilities to do evil are held at Catastrophe Prison. Shu Ono, a guard at the prison, somehow fell in love with the strongest female prisoner Lava! A crazy love-comedy about the forbidden relationship between guard and prisoner!

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

It’s not good to have too many vices. You may not know this, but there’s a limit to the vices you can commit. Once you’ve exceeded that limit… You’ll be labeled by the system as a “sinner” and receive punishment from the supervisors!

139611.description:
Hinata did it. He got reincarnated into another world, took up the mantle of Hero, and slew the dreaded Demon Lord alongside his party of fellow adventurers. As his reward, he’s returned to Earth to resume a normal life. Or it would be if it wasn’t for the fact that his dark elf companion Mariabelle decided to travel to Earth to come and live with him! Now she uses her arcane talents to ward off any potential romantic rivals and capture Hinata’s affection.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

139612.description: A warm, tender, and sad story about Nene, who loved to eat.

139613.description: The legend of Norse mythology we are all familiar with, Odin is the strongest of them all. His master orders him to go to Earth, where he meets a high school girl with the ability to see God. However, a mysterious accident causes her to die! She is brought back to life by the spring of wisdom and taken to Asgard, where she lives as a goddess. A secret that no one knows... and the story of the gods.

139614.description:
Yukino works part-time at a maid cafe against company regulations, because it makes her happy to be able to wear her favorite maid uniform... But then Yukino got a visitor, the president of the company! "What should I do! We're not allowed to have side jobs, so I'll never get away with this..." Yukino was ready to be fired, but the boss unexpectedly offered her a job as a "live-in maid"...? In his high-rise apartment with a beautiful night view and an elegant dinner, Yukino falls in love with the dreamy, sweet president.

(Source: Kanon Mia Comics, translated)

title.native: ご主人様は社長(このヒト)です！

139615.description: There is a woman called Elizabeth Bathory who is more beautiful than anyone. She who took care of her beauty with the blood of young girls, gave birth to a son named Miguel. No one knows anything about that son as he grows up to become a human-eating monster.

139616.description: The nine-year-old girl Rutsubo doesn't like her father, and has made up her mind to never forgive him for abandoning her right after she was born. But when her guardians take a two-month vacation, she's forced to live with him for the first time. Live with him, fine -- but that doesn't mean she has to talk to him. This is the story of a silent, withdrawn girl and the complicated father who hopes to win her over.

139617.description: This tells the story of two brothers, one a cop and the other an aspiring songwriter, who find themselves mixed up in the student protests of the late 1960's in Japan that are being led by a Christ-like folk singer.

139618.description:
Finding love despite everything.
Young-Jun Kim has a stutter due to a traumatic incident from his past. A girl from his childhood shows up again in his life. Together they learn to enjoy their everyday lives, fully embracing their individual challenges as theme park cast members.

(Source: Manta)

139619.description:
After just graduating college and starting full-time work, Yano is often the target of his intense colleague, Kuro, who's training him. During his own welcome party, Yano gets up to use the restroom...and finds Kuro covered in bite marks and bruises from some rough loving while caught up in a dirty conversation with one of his male clients on the phone. Yano thought he hated Kuro, but after seeing his hot body...

(Source: Renta!)

Ehara arrived at romance novelist Kajii’s house to work as a part-time housekeeper, yet he was suddenly ordered to brew coffee and then somehow became Kajii’s assistant instead?

June 1983...has passed. At long last, through many trials and tribulations, Rika and her friends have finally escaped the tragedy! The gameboard has been cleared, the pieces scattered, and all that remains is the rest of her life. Or so Rika believes, until she gets pulled into yet another fragment...

(Source: Yen Press)

139625.description:
Best friends turned lovers in a single night...?

"The only one who can ever be with someone like me is you!!" Office worker Isejima suddenly goes down on his knees to propose to bar owner Yakumo, his best friend of ten years.

Jilted by his bride-to-be before their wedding, Isejima pleads his case about being single for the rest of his life and his fear of dying alone. Taken aback by Isejima's ardent words, Yakumo nonetheless feels moved enough to unthinkingly accept!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Chiyo recklessly harbours an unrequited love for this Hashida. She becomes acquainted with Hashida as their seats are next to each other and she also discovers that Hashida harbours an unrequited love for Kaneishi. However, Kaneishi also harbours an unrequited love for someone else...

139628.description:
Kuro Ariba was born into an elite status. After finding a job working in sales, he runs into trouble getting clients to sign on the dotted line and resorts to selling his body to sweeten his deals. His figures start to improve, so one day his apathetic coworker Akusu goes out on a sales call with him to learn Kuro's secret...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: エリートサラリーマン枕営業メス堕ちマニュアル

139629.description:
Yukichi Jimii is hopelessly in love with Shizujiro Harari, his boss who hates him. Every time the quiet and dull Yukichi makes a move on Shizujiro, Shizujiro calls him incompetent and tells him he loathes him. One day after returning from an apartment inspection, Yukichi comes across a secretly - taken photo of Shizujiro in a very compromising position. Yukichi sees this as his chance to make Shizujiro his and confronts him...

(Source: Renta!)

Notes: Includes one extra chapter.

139631.description:
Ikuo's always making one mistake after the other at work. A particularly huge one is covered up by his coworker Benio, who in return asks him to dress up in some especially revealing women's underwear. Streaming for all his followers under the handle "Penio," Benio decides to give his fans the wild banging session they've been asking for, with Ikuo as the co - star...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: This Flower Only Blossoms For Men
title.native: 男にだけ咲くメスの花
title.romaji: Otoko ni Dake Saku Mesu no Hana

139632.description:
Hajun's a scary gangster who can quiet even a crying baby with his stare. He's put in charge of spying on Ibara, a local host, who's been accused of selling drugs on his gang's turf. It turns out, though, Hajun and Ibara are actually a lovey - dovey couple! Being seven years older, Hajun can't help succumbing when Ibara gives him his puppy - dog eyes. The two wind up on camera screwing for other gang members to see...
Also features his first time with man, a humiliating yet pleasurable experience!!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: First published under the title 'Kasshoku Yakuza Chijoku no Kejime' as a doujinshi, afterwards officially released under the current title.

title.english: The Tanned Gangster Takes Shameful Responsibility / Room With A View

139633.description:
High school boy Ryoki Toraga is too honest and straight-laced to attract a girlfriend, until he was visited by a cute savior from heaven! But who is she? Elle is an angel who is awkward in love and in her work, as she keeps getting flustered by Ryoki's straight-forwardness! With the help of the other girls around them, their search for "The One" is off to a wild start!

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

title.native: えるのわ！～恋愛弱者とペケ天使～
title.romaji: Erunowa!: Renai Jakusha to Peke Tenshi

139634.description:
Kaito Tenchi is a genius scientist of rare talent. One day, he wakes up to find that he has been transported to another world. What Kaito has obtained is a rare magic called "Creation," which can create almost anything he sees once (except for plants). Kaito is rescued by Luminous, a female mercenary, and lives with her, earning money by using creation magic, and spending his days peacefully and happily, but he gets involved in various disturbances. Use your unparalleled brain and creative magic to lay waste to your enemies!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Kaito Tenchi is a genius researcher of rare talent. One day, he wakes up to find that he has been transported to another world.
